layouts.name: Rissington Kart Circuit
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Rissington Inner Circuit, Rissington Gearbox Circuit. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Rissington Inner Circuit
layouts.description: The club Inner Circuit plan identifies the full northern hairpin, inner southern loop and eastern dog-leg. The independently mapped centreline measures 983.7 m, compared with the club rounded distance of 970 m. The outer gearbox shortcut and pit roads are excluded.

layouts.name: Rissington Gearbox Circuit
layouts.description: The club Gearbox Circuit plan identifies the full northern hairpin and long outer southern return, bypassing the inner loop and eastern dog-leg. The pinned source loop measures 868.2 m, while the published plan states 970 m. This discrepancy remains recorded; coordinates are not adjusted.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: The general venue configuration represents both the club Inner Circuit and Gearbox Circuit branches. Separate published club plans identify the inner loop, eastern dog-leg and outer gearbox return. Each named route is independently mapped and selectable; their union is displayed as a network rather than one lap. The unique mapped branch length is 1300.5 m and is not stretched to the catalogue distance of 1258 m. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
